stem.text: Barium dithionate, $\text{BaS}_2\text{O}_6\bullet 2\text{H}_2\text{O}$, is soluble in water.
$\text{S}_2\text{O}_6^{2-}$ ions slowly decompose in acidic solution.
$3.513\,\text{g}$ of $\text{BaS}_2\text{O}_6\bullet 2\text{H}_2\text{O}$ is dissolved in water in a $100\,\text{cm}^3$ volumetric flask and the solution made up to the mark with $\text{HCl(aq)}$.
At time $x\,\text{min}$, a white precipitate of mass $0.661\,\text{g}$ is present in the flask.
What is the concentration of $\text{BaS}_2\text{O}_6$ in the volumetric flask at time $x\,\text{min}$?
